lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Don't touch that handle [beat] because the house just registered our fingerprints and it is sealing every single exit shut!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Nix, I can see a figure [beat] standing right there behind the frosted glass, and it looks exactly like your Grandpa!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That's impossible because Grandpa has been in Florida for weeks [beat] but whoever that is, they're holding the master override key!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: You were never supposed to find the observation deck [beat] and now that you have, the house has no choice but to initiate protocol seven.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Grandpa? [beat] Why are you appearing on a holographic screen, and what on earth do you mean by protocol seven?

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: This house isn't just a building [beat] it is a living, breathing security vault meant to protect the family’s greatest secret from the neighbors.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: The walls are literally shifting [beat] and I think I can hear the sound of massive gears grinding underneath our very feet right now!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Tell us how to stop this [beat] or we are going to be crushed by the rotating kitchen floor before the sun even goes down!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: The Architect designed the system to be irreversible [beat] unless you can provide the biometric scan of the first-born grandchild immediately.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: That is your sister Tuli [beat] but she is at the mall and there is no way we can get her here in time!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, look at the screen [beat] there is a countdown starting and the shadow behind the glass is finally stepping into the light!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I told your father that you kids would be too nosey [beat] and now I have to be the one to clean up this mechanical mess.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Phupu?! [beat] You are the Architect behind this entire nightmare [beat] and you have been watching us from the attic this whole time?

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: The real show is just beginning [beat] because the basement is about to open and you are not going to like what is inside!
